recipes.title: Tetsu Kasuya 4:6 Method (basic)
recipes.description: Tetsu Kasuya's World Brewers Cup-winning 4:6 pour-over: five equal pours — the first 40% of the water tunes taste, the last 60% sets strength.
recipes.notes: The original specifies a grind between medium-coarse and coarse; size carries the finer end of that range. Philocoffea publishes this method on a Japanese page and an English one, and they disagree on two pours: the Japanese original cues the fourth at 2:10 and the fifth at 2:40, the English translation at 2:15 and 2:45. This document follows the Japanese, which is the language the method was published in first.
